defs.def: the conditions that affect the behaviour and development of sb/sth; the physical conditions that sb/sth exists in （影响个体行为或事物发展的）环境；客观环境

ex.s: “If you go to a forest, you have a given environment and temperature.
ex.t: “如果你走进森林，你就处在一个既定的环境和温度中。

ex.s: They purify the environment.
ex.t: 它们净化环境。

ex.s: In addition, there’s no need for pesticides and other chemicals that pollute traditional farms and the surrounding environment.
ex.t: 此外，还不需要杀虫剂和其他污染传统农场及周边环境的化学品。

ex.s: “We are passionate about reducing waste, carbon and chemicals in our environment,” said a BMF employee.
ex.t: 我们热衷于减少环境中的废弃物、碳排放和化学品，”一位BMF员工说。

ex.s: They use their noses to assess their environment and look out for any signs of danger.
ex.t: 它们用鼻子来评估周围环境，并留意任何危险的迹象。

ex.s: Our formative environment as a species was information-poor, so our brains developed a mechanism that prized new information.
ex.t: 作为人类，我们形成期的环境是信息匮乏的，因此我们的大脑形成了一种重视新信息的机制。

ex.s: But global connectivity has greatly changed our information environment.
ex.t: 但全球互联已经在很大程度上改变了我们的信息环境。

ex.s: Protect the information environment.
ex.t: 保护信息环境。

ex.s: The similarity of moral virtues across cultures is striking, even though the relative ranking of the virtues may vary with a social group’s history and environment.
ex.t: 道德美德在各文化间的相似性令人惊叹，尽管这些美德的相对排序可能随社会群体的历史和环境而变化。

ex.s: “Solar projects need to be good neighbors,” says Jordan Macknick, the head of the Innovative Site Preparation and Impact Reductions on the Environment(InSPIRE)project.
ex.t: "太阳能项目需要做好邻居，"创新场地准备与环境影响力减损（InSPIRE）项目负责人乔丹·麦克尼克说。

ex.s: Adapting to new environments.
ex.t: 适应新环境。

ex.s: Build respect for and awareness of the environment and cultural practices.
ex.t: 培养对环境和文化习俗的尊重与意识。

ex.s: The tests show that the social environment is extremely influential when we’re making decisions.
ex.t: 测试表明，当我们做决定时，社会环境的影响极大。

ex.s: That’s bad news for the environment — and our wallets — as these outdated devices consume much more energy than the newer ones that do the same things.
ex.t: 对环境来说这是个坏消息——对我们的钱包也是如此——因为这些过时的设备比做同样事情的新设备消耗更多的能源。

ex.s: China’s approach to protecting its environment while   70   (feed) its citizens “offers useful lessons for agriculture and food policymakers worldwide,” says the bank’s Juergen Voegele.

ex.s: Many people suspect that all the rock salt used every winter is harming the environment.
ex.t: 许多人怀疑每年使用的所有岩盐都在损害环境。

ex.s: Settings: time, location and descriptions of the environment or surroundings help your readers picture the scene.
ex.t: 设置：时间、地点以及对环境或周围环境的描述有助于你的读者在脑海中构想出场景。

ex.s: “People who live in plant-rich environments report a higher life satisfaction rating, ” she says.
ex.t: “生活在植物丰富环境中的人，报告了更高的生活满意度，”她说。

defs.def: the natural world in which people, animals and plants live 自然环境；生态环境

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即便这种计时方式在细节上很新颖，早期的农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来。例如在前古典时期的希腊，人们会通过把日期向前或向后调整来“修正”官方历法，以反映季节的变化。与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要。同样，我们正在开发的河流时间和其他计时系统或许也能唤起人们的环保意识。

ex.s: Its natural environment.
ex.t: 那里的自然环境。

ex.s: It allows one to work in the natural environment.
ex.t: 允许在自然环境中工作。

ex.s: In many of the places where the butterfly can be found, people are destroying the natural environment.
ex.t: 在许多能发现这种蝴蝶的地方，人们正在破坏自然环境。

ex.s: One of the best things about this job is that you can observe animals in their natural environment.
ex.t: 这项工作的最好之处之一是，您可以在自然环境中观察动物。

defs.def: the complete structure within which a user, computer or program operates （运行）环境；工作平台；软件包

ex.s: When hiring committees see this, they see candidate who is capable of working in a variety of environments.
ex.t: 当雇用委员会看到这一点时，他们就会看到能够在各种环境中工作的候选人。

ex.s: Harmony in the work environment.
ex.t: 工作环境的和谐。

ex.s: You should be able to work well in a team and adapt to an international working environment．
ex.t: 你应该能够在团队中良好协作，并适应国际化工作环境。

ex.s: Build your social life around people your work environment.
ex.t: 围绕工作环境中的人建立你的社交生活。

ex.s: These terraces also provide a perfect environment for birds and fish.
ex.t: 这些梯田也为鸟类和鱼类提供了一个完美的环境。
